title: Camping, Overlanding & RV Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Victron telemetry (`victron:telemetry`), iOverlander place logs (`ioverlander:place`), Garmin inReach messages (`inreach:message`), and Mopeka propane readings (`mopeka:tank`).
app: Victron Cerbo GX telemetry, iOverlander place exports, Garmin inReach check-ins, and Mopeka propane sensors streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=victron:telemetry) OR (index=personal sourcetype=ioverlander:place)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="victron:telemetry","primary",sourcetype="ioverlander:place","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from victron:telemetry and ioverlander:place to see whether two camping, overlanding feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `victron:telemetry` and `ioverlander:place` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main camping, overlanding data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
